name: creatorconnect
description: CreatorConnect — professional networking and collaboration marketplace for creators, brands and businesses.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
